questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
questions.answer: Explore new cultures

questions.question: Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: Et universitet hvor det virkere som om, at de havde styr på tingene. Et sted jeg ikke kendte.

questions.question: How would you rate your overall study abroad experience? *
Additional comments:
How easy was it to find the information you needed to know upon arrival? *
questions.answer: Meget nemt. Universitetet lagde virkelig mange informationer op.

questions.question: What assistance, if any, did you receive when you arrived at your study destination? *
questions.answer: Der var et internationalt kontor på uni, som kunne hjælpe med alle spørgsmål.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the orientation and assistance available to students at your host institution upon arrival? *
Additional comments
How did you find housing? *
questions.answer: I found housing on my own

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: Off campus

questions.question: How easy was it to find off campus housing? Any recommendations? *
questions.answer: Jeg fandt det på airbnb. Vær i god tid, og prøv at forhandle med prisen, når man lejer over længere tid.

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *
questions.answer:
Vær i godt tid. Det kan være virkelig svært at finde.
Jeg boede i centrum, hvilket var virkelig fedt. Dog gik man lidt glip af det store fællesskab der var mellem dem der boede på campus. Men hvis man får nogle gode venner der bor der, kan man nemt blive en del af det:)

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer:
Hvis du skal bo på campus, kan man vælge mellem Johanna og Cambridgelaan. Johanna er vist lidt dyrere, men meget nyere og lækrere faciliteter. 
På cambridgelaan skal man ikke være sart... Hverken med potentielle roomies eller faciliteter

questions.question: How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: Der var en masse steps man skulle igennem, men man fik en masse mails med guide og påmindelser om de vigtigste ting. Ikke noget at være bekymret for.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: Man kan altid skrive til International Office. De svarer hurtigt og er meget hjælpsomme.

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: Jeg fik alle de kurser jeg ville.

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Vælg fag baseret på interesse og type af eksamen. Stor forskel på sværhedsgrad af fagene.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Did you take BA or MA classes while you were on exchange *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer:
Det var en blandet oplevelse. Fagene virkede meget nemme, men eksamen er anderledes end i Danmark. Mange flere tests og prøver. 
Dog var fagenes indhold meget ligetil. Hvis man læser og dukker op til forelæsningerne er man godt med!

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: Lavere niveau. Forelæsning var lidt det samme som UCPH. Seminarerne var ikke så brugbare. Det var lidt gymnasie-agtig med fravær, gennemgang af lektier, ræk hånden op etc.

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer:
Wild years? Researching youth in different cultures
Risk behavior and addiction in adolescence
Youth culture in a digital world
Science of happiness.

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer:
Wild years? Researching youth in different cultures var et spændende og meget nemt fag. Mere metode end hvad jeg havde forventet. 
Risk behavior and addiction in adolescence var det mest spændende men også sværeste fag. Kan klart anbefale - især hvis man har lidt psykologi baggrundsviden (det manglede jeg lidt). 
Youth culture in a digital world var virkelig et spændende fag og ok nemt. 
Science of happiness var kedeligt og svær eksamen. Kan ikke anbefale.

questions.answer:
Offentlig transport var dyrere end forventet. 
Billigt at spise på restaurant og gå på bar.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the non-academic opportunities (clubs, sports, etc.) at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
What kinds of cultural, athletic and social activities were available for students at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Jeg deltog ikke rigtig i noget, men der var rigtig mange muligheder både med sport og andre typer aktiviteter.

questions.question: Which non -academic activities would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Jeg deltog ikke i nogle specifikke aktiviteter. Jeg brugte min tid på at være sammen med mine venner, som jeg fik dernede.

questions.question: What do you recommend other visiting students see or do on their weekends or holidays? *
questions.answer:
Beton-T: sted i Utrecht med mange aktiviteter og loppemarkeder. 
Antwerpen: kun 2 timer væk med flixbus. En smuttur til Belgien og en meget smuk by. 
Slotte i Utrecht: en cykeltur væk fra byen med flot natur. 
Andre byer i Holland: Rotterdam, Eindhoven, Amsterdam.

questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of your exchange site? *
questions.answer: Meget nemt. Ikke en store kulturforskel.

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
questions.answer: Vær god til at snakke med folk i timerne. Mange af de hollandske studerende kender heller ikke nogen på  kurserne, så de fleste er glade for, at nogen vil tale med dem. Dog vil jeg anbefale at lægge min energi hos de andre internationale studerende. De hollandske studerende holder sig lidt for sig selv.

questions.question: What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: Der va rikke rigtig nogen.

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: At bruge byen meget. Folk sidder på restauranter og barer året rundt på alle ugens dage. Dejligt med en by fuld af liv.

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer:
Få fat i en cykel!
Husk regntøj.
Deltag i introugen. Perfekt mulighed for at møde en masse mennesker.

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: Vær opmærksom på muligheder (eller mangel på samme) for re-eksamen.

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: Alle de nye relationer og venskaber jeg har fået. Man bliver tætte på en helt anden måde, når man kun har hinanden væk fra sine vante rammer.

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: At der ikke var nok tid.

questions.question: Any other comments?
questions.answer: Kan klart anbefale Utrecht. Det er en virkelig smuk, romantisk og dejlig by med historie, natur og fuld af liv. Kan sammenlignes meget med Amsterdam, bare mindre og hyggeligere. Virkelig god studieby, men mange unge mennesker og studierabat de fleste steder. Et godt universitet.

questions.question: Do you agree to share your travel report with other fellow students? *
questions.answer: Yes
